data.body:
Live A6-0b deployment evidence (2026-08-04 UTC). Merged code is 93a40f7d6f5da6b34e1d15ba9db630e0093a7ba9 (Gerrit 1352; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). One-time hand bootstrap used SSM on i-00880b2c7f13527c5, account 896586841071/us-east-1. Preflight showed review health {status:ok,in_flight:0}, old container 0d6168..., old image sha256:4395cd9f..., persistent tickets HEAD/origin tip 5e522cad07df97b9af030be4ae4a32053c9198d1, and the deployed autodeploy body still at old hash 5994f447....

Hand-bootstrap receipts: b004b9e7-6313-4bbc-8d2b-5a995580e149 updated the mirror, installed autodeploy.sh as 502:502 mode 0755, re-armed the marker, started the service, and restarted the timer (all shell steps exit 0), but the subsequent receipt exposed that my command encoded the prior SHA with a trailing literal n, so classifier git-diff was unreadable and no rebuild occurred. c9bc6789-b1f9-47e9-92dc-8ad82c6c6a32 wrote the exact prior SHA but hit systemd start-limit (exit 1) before executing the service; the healthy old bot remained live and the timer trap restored the timer. After `systemctl reset-failed`, 295bb192-8103-4696-97d8-a0fdc2ac2bee completed exit 0 and performed the real deployment. These unsuccessful attempts are recorded explicitly; neither changed the healthy running bot.

Successful receipt: deployed-sha and mirror HEAD both equal 93a40f7d6f5da6b34e1d15ba9db630e0093a7ba9; installed autodeploy hash 92f13021c7f0390468adec7a675a830e1a8eec60fedae81b27d884a0624a4dc6; installed ensure hash f1f73f27bf125297249dc58a737e057b90eb8cf884d3a1b0ea023b1422de665e. Autodeploy journal records `review-bot sources or secrets changed`, image build sha256:a267497a57ccafb8b9db65fbbcb6dd25c76cf8dca483237d5f5ab82bf5725514, container recreation, `review-bot redeployed + healthy`, and `deploy complete`. New container ab2b0291867a... reports GET /health = {status:ok,in_flight:0}; timer is active. Startup journal records every ensure ok, `is a writable rebar store`, `Application startup complete`, and Uvicorn listening.

Persistent-clone convergence: old tip 5e522cad07df97b9af030be4ae4a32053c9198d1 -> new HEAD 5c0430de0ba19a2c166754a3fd30627b64f0cd7f, exactly equal to refs/remotes/origin/tickets; old is an ancestor of new. No MERGE_HEAD, no rebase state, stash count 0, and tracked diff count 0. Two pre-existing untracked event JSONs remain and are being dispositioned separately; they predated the deployment and did not affect ref convergence.

Deployed-runtime refusal probe ran inside the new container against a disposable repo (SSM 7e3d7900-d785-407b-ac88-9222187c7e6d, exit 0). It pinned the remote commit and returned: `tickets store epoch guard refused the operation: store epoch mismatch: local epoch 'probe-E1'; remote <pinned sha> epoch 'probe-E2'; re-clone the tracker before retrying`. The disposable probe left the persistent clone untouched.
